name: Lubrication (dry-sump oiling)
description: Converts the ZL1 LT4 (factory wet sump, ~10 qt) to a multi-stage dry-sump system: billet pan, belt-driven external pump, remote de-aerating tank, remote filter, thermostatically controlled oil cooler and -12/-16 AN plumbing.

components.name: Factory LT4 wet-sump oil pan (ZL1 baseline, replaced by dry sump)
components.description: IMPORTANT: the 6th-gen Camaro ZL1 LT4 left the factory with a WET-sump oiling system (only the C7 Corvette Z06/Z51 LT engines got the factory dry sump). The ZL1 cast-aluminum pan holds ~10 qt and uses the internal variable-displacement vane pump. Listed here as the baseline and as the fallback configuration if the race engine stays wet-sump (add a baffle/trap-door kit and an Accusump in that case).
components.location: Bottom of the engine block, between the front subframe rails; filter pad at the front passenger-side corner of the pan.

components.name: Dry-sump oil pan (billet, Gen V LT)
components.description: Shallow billet-aluminum pan that replaces the wet sump. Scavenge pickups (one per section / crank bay pair) pull oil out of the crankcase as fast as it drains so the crank never windages through oil, and the shallow depth allows a lower engine position. Includes a pressure-oil inlet that feeds filtered, cooled oil into the block main gallery.
components.location: Bolted to the bottom of the LT block and front/rear covers; lowest point of the engine.

factory.name: None on Camaro (ZL1 is wet sump). GM C7 Corvette Z06 LT4 factory dry-sump pan exists; Chevrolet Performance 25534412 hose adapters bolt to the factory LT1/LT4 dry-sump pan to accept -12 AN.
